description: This file defines the ConnectionEventProducer interface for producing connection events (connect/disconnect) in the Eclipse Hono project, mainly for monitoring and debugging connection-oriented protocols like MQTT or AMQP 1.0.

classes.name: ConnectionEventProducer
classes.description: Interface for producing connection events (connect/disconnect) for monitoring purposes.

classes.name: ConnectionEventProducer.Context
classes.description: Context object providing message sender client for connection event producers.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Produces an event indicating a new connection has been established.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Produces an event indicating a connection has been closed.
